profile.notes: Media tool for the TaroKit portal (iframe-embedded), a local-only CapCut alternative. Sibling of image-annotator/json-formatter etc.; match their quality bar and conventions. All media stays on device, never uploaded.

gate.note: Greenfield; profile reused from image-annotator; balanced autonomy; tooling OK

decisions.question: M-1 scope
decisions.answer: light multi-track in M-1 (owner chose against recommendation; accepts ~2-3x larger M-1 + audio-mix spike)

decisions.question: Phone support in M-1
decisions.answer: full editor on phone in M-1 (owner chose against recommendation; accepts phone design/QA + memory risk)

decisions.question: MPL-2.0 muxer (mediabunny) vs permissive-only policy
decisions.answer: spike permissive muxers first in phase 3; bring ADR exception for unmodified MPL-2.0 if needed; no WASM FFmpeg AAC

decisions.question: On-device storage
decisions.answer: temp OPFS scratch during export only, deleted after; nothing persists between sessions in M-1; project save reconsidered with ADR later

decisions.question: Pitch
decisions.answer: privacy-led

decisions.question: Music source in M-1
decisions.answer: user's own audio + a bundled pack of free-licence tracks (licence allow-list to confirm at brief approval)

decisions.question: Max export length
decisions.answer: 10 minutes

decisions.question: M-1 extras
decisions.answer: photo clips, fades, basic adjustments, GIF + audio-only export

decisions.question: Colour filters + powerful colour adjustment in M-1
decisions.answer: owner request: trending colour filters (self-authored LUTs, intensity slider) + full colour adjustment panel in M-1

decisions.question: Music pack licence allow-list
decisions.answer: CC0 / public domain only

decisions.question: Approve vision brief
decisions.answer: approved 2026-11-03

decisions.question: 5K screen recordings
decisions.answer: accept up to 5120x2880, scaled down for editing

decisions.question: Touch scrubbing model
decisions.answer: fixed centre playhead (owner chose against recommendation)

decisions.question: HDR sources
decisions.answer: SDR output only; HDR converted identically in preview and export

decisions.question: Rotation changes Original aspect
decisions.answer: yes

decisions.question: Text/audio on ripple
decisions.answer: stay at fixed times

decisions.question: Offline asset download
decisions.answer: all at first visit

decisions.question: Cancelled save dialog
decisions.answer: not counted as export where detectable

decisions.question: GIF and unexported warning
decisions.answer: GIF never clears it

decisions.question: Size target unreachable
decisions.answer: export disabled, smallest feasible MB offered

decisions.question: Audio clip move overlap
decisions.answer: nearest free gap where it fits whole, else cancelled

decisions.question: Mute original sound
decisions.answer: one-time action with Unmute counterpart

decisions.question: Keyframes non-goal
decisions.answer: non-goal for M-1/M-2; M-3 candidate

decisions.question: Touch scroll during playback
decisions.answer: pauses, then scrubs (follows D-013) (confirmed by owner at G1)

decisions.question: Add music with playhead at project end
decisions.answer: starts at 0 (confirmed by owner at G1)

decisions.question: Mixed touch+pointer devices
decisions.answer: touch behaviour per input, not per device (confirmed by owner at G1)

decisions.question: Audio move: original place free
decisions.answer: yes; nearest fit to requested start; no-op if result is original place (confirmed by owner at G1)

environment.stack_hint: Preact+Vite+TypeScript+vitest+Playwright+Cloudflare static (confirm in phase 3); video via WebCodecs (spike)

spike_candidates.q: Decode H.264/HEVC/VP9 sources and encode H.264+audio per engine (Chromium, Safari 26 macOS/iOS, Firefox desktop, Chrome Android)
spike_candidates.pass: feature-detect matrix; every engine has a defined output (Firefox: MP4+Opus or WebM)

spike_candidates.q: Can we ship a muxer/demuxer under the permissive-only policy (mediabunny is MPL-2.0)?
spike_candidates.pass: owner-approved ADR exception for unmodified MPL, or permissive alternative proven; no WASM FFmpeg AAC

spike_candidates.q: One paint(t) compositor (VideoDecoder->canvas) for preview and export
spike_candidates.pass: export within 1 frame / 2 px of preview; A/V drift <40 ms over 10 min

spike_candidates.q: 10-min 1080p and 2-min 4K survive on iPhone and mid Android; also 5120x2880 screen recordings scaled to 2160p (D-012)
spike_candidates.pass: no tab crash; streaming input via Blob.slice

spike_candidates.q: Background tab mid-export, download path on iOS
spike_candidates.pass: interruption detected; clean resume/restart; save works

spike_candidates.q: WebCodecs, workers, downloads, OPFS inside the portal iframe; if multithreaded encoding needs cross-origin isolation headers, the host frame contract (RULE-17) must add them — raise with portal
spike_candidates.pass: all work embedded or standalone fallback

spike_candidates.q: Temporary on-device storage (OPFS scratch) vs suite no-persistence rule
spike_candidates.pass: owner rules; project save stays out until an ADR

spike_candidates.q: WebGL2/WebGPU shader colour pipeline + 3D LUT, shared preview/export
spike_candidates.pass: 1080p30 preview >=30fps laptop, >=24fps recent phone; export vs preview deltaE<2

spike_candidates.q: HDR->SDR conversion identical in preview and export across engines (D-014)
spike_candidates.pass: HLG/PQ phone fixtures match within NFR-08 between preview and export on every engine

spike_candidates.q: Per-resolution bitrate floors and size estimation (RULE-15)
spike_candidates.pass: estimate within ±25%, target never exceeded on fixtures
